title: GSSSB Notification 2026 - Apply Online for 82 Municipal Accountant Posts
description: Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB) has declared the official notification for 2026. To fill the vacancies for 82 Municipal Accountant Jobs. Candidates who have qualified in the B.E/ B.Tech can grab this chance and apply for the GSSSB Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
